entities.title: Opening one's own invitation link shows an empty error toast
entities.summary: When the address holds an invitation the player sent themselves and it is still open, the lobby shows a red toast with no text.
entities.expected: Nothing is said: the invitation is under Waiting for an answer (GDD decision log, the build's open points).
entities.observed: The lobby's first refresh does not find the id among Invitations for you, asks api/challenges/{id}, gets the open invitation (200), and falls through to toast(c.error, true) with an empty error.
reproduction: Open its link (…/?challenge=ID) in the same browser
acceptanceCriteria: An open invitation the player sent shows no toast.

origin.description: Main._lobby's handling of the invitation in the address, against docs/GDD.md's decision log.

entities.title: Split main.gd by screen
entities.summary: main.gd builds every screen (home, sign-in, setup, lobby, contact, history) as well as switching between them, and game_screen.gd holds the whole game screen.
acceptanceCriteria: Each screen is its own script in godot/scripts/screens/, with that folder's component and class diagrams; main.gd keeps the Main machine (go) and the wiring.
Each use case sits in the folder of the screen that runs it, and the actor file's links follow it.
The Godot tests pass, and play is unchanged.

origin.description: The owner asked for a plan to refactor retro-games so that it shows everything the cyberspace explorer can show, and approved its Phase 0.
